description: Target Corporation was incorporated in Minnesota in 1902, and its corporate purpose is to help all families discover the joy of everyday life, offering its customers, referred to as guests, fashionable, differentiated merchandise and everyday essentials at discounted prices, and it operates as a single segment designed to enable guests to purchase products seamlessly in stores or through its digital channels. Since 1946 it has given 5 percent of its profit to communities. Its strategy is grounded in its purpose to help all families discover the joy of everyday life and its ambition to be the most delightful experience in retail, differentiating through design, style and value, and a curated multi-category assortment delivered across stores and digital channels, and it reported net sales of $104.8 billion in 2025, $106.6 billion in 2024 and $107.4 billion in 2023.
